Name: API design and state machines
Core ideas: Classes, method contracts, validation, errors, encapsulation, valid transitions and invariants.

Name: Queues and backpressure
Core ideas: FIFO buffers, capacity, ring buffers, producer-consumer coordination, blocking and graceful shutdown.

Name: Caches and key-value stores
Core ideas: Lookup, ordering, eviction, versioned reads, compound updates and separating cache policy from storage.

Name: Time, expiry and rate limits
Core ideas: Clock injection, deadlines, TTL, time windows, leases, renewal and exact boundary behaviour.

Name: Thread safety and coordination
Core ideas: Shared memory, interleavings, critical sections, mutual exclusion, signalling, lock scope and deadlocks.

Name: Worker pools and scheduling
Core ideas: Futures, bounded in-flight work, dynamic tasks, deduplication, result collection and worker lifecycle.

Name: Async I/O and cancellation
Core ideas: Coroutines, tasks, await points, event-loop blocking, bounded concurrency, deadlines and cleanup.

Name: Streaming and incremental parsing
Core ideas: Chunk boundaries, incremental decoding, partial records, ordering, finite buffers and end-of-stream handling.

Name: Retries and failure handling
Core ideas: Transient versus permanent failures, attempt budgets, backoff, idempotency, circuit breakers and dead letters.

Name: Persistence and recovery
Core ideas: Serialization, atomic file replacement, transaction boundaries, uniqueness constraints and restart recovery.

Name: Testing, debugging and observability
Core ideas: Behavioural tests, fake dependencies, forced interleavings, fault injection, profiling, metrics and structured logs.

Name: Integrated service exercises
Core ideas: Combine APIs, concurrency, expiry, bounded work, recovery and instrumentation in a small running service.
Python tools: http.server or familiar framework; tools from T01-T11
